code_first_review.scar: The first policy draft accepted a caller-provided hasVisibleLastGoodContact boolean without a canonical frame predicate. That would invite node-count heuristics and misclassify a valid zero-material pulse. The source was corrected before completion with hasVisibleLastGoodContact(frame) based on non-empty visiblePulseId, plus regression and skill updates.

mission_fidelity.detail: Multiple independent non-P0 fronts advanced through GitHub: pure poll policy, regression source, durable repository skill, existing warm-wall SVG mutation, and evidence/review.

accessibility_review.detail: The policy prevents a disappeared persisted heartbeat from silently presenting stale last-good contact as current and prevents unchanged 200ms polls from earning repeated projection/UI/speech work. Runtime TalkBack behavior remains unproven.

art_review.detail: The existing vector warm wall was mutated in place with WAITING != CONTACT LOST and timestamp-churn != semantic-work semantics; no raster or decorative autoplay was added.

architecture_review.detail: No duplicate overlay/poller/cache controller or P0/phone recovery organ was created. The intended owner remains OperatorOverlayService.

evidence_review.detail: Durable GitHub source and readback are real. Regression execution and existing-owner consumption are not. Automatic CI executed zero steps because the Actions budget prevented the job from starting.

she_raw.detail: Authoritative ambient consultation returned account-connection HTTP 400; no synthetic She-Raw review was substituted.
